items.q: arrangements like Fletcher Henderson and Jimmy Mundy... So that's when Benny went out and hired Fletcher Henderson

ctx.x: The notion was that swing had replaced jazz.

Yes, and -- yeah, it's not funny, you know, when you consider -- well, swing definitely had to do with the big bands and jazz was always a small thing. I mean when you get over five pieces, you know, and it's swing because then you're involved in arrangements where in jazz -- the traditional jazz material, it's not arranged, but every man knows what part he's supposed to play and all that.
